input.section_basis: Unchanged assigned finished sections, physical member/part IDs and saved allocation.
input.load_transfer: Uniform pressure and weight are integrated over each installed source interval and its actual bearings. Adjacent covering spans use simple tributary reactions; no covering stiffness is credited. Seams do not transfer loads to bearings on another source part. Overhang reactions may require unverified hold-down. Structural self-weight uses distributed tributary nodal lumping on the saved mesh; it is not concentrated at the whole-part centroid.
input.boundary: Conceptual structural analysis — stated assumptions. No structural approval or certified grade.
